condition_details.mutation_type: Condition inversion (negating regular file check -f to ! -f)
condition_details.purpose: Guards execution of SDK path.zsh.inc so SDK binaries are added to PATH only when file exists
condition_details.protected_behavior: When CLOUDSDK_HOME contains path.zsh.inc, it is sourced to configure PATH and environment
condition_details.expected_failure_when_mutated: When mutated with [[ ! -f ... ]], existing path.zsh.inc is skipped, leaving PATH unmodified and failing regression assertion T10

tests.name: T02_custom_cloudsdk_home_preserved

tests.name: T04_path_inc_missing_clean

tests.name: T05_completion_sourced_success
tests.description: Completion: completion.zsh.inc is sourced when present

tests.name: T06_completion_missing_clean
tests.description: Edge-state: missing completion file exits cleanly without error

tests.name: T07_no_sdk_installed_clean
tests.description: Edge-state: unconfigured environment without SDK installed completes cleanly

tests.name: T08_argument_quoting_and_execution
tests.description: Argument preservation: gcloud forwards multi-word arguments with spaces intact

tests.name: T09_failure_propagation
tests.description: Failure propagation: gcloud propagates non-zero exit status on error

tests.name: T10_REGRESSION_path_inc_condition
tests.description: Regression guard: verifies [[ -f "${CLOUDSDK_HOME}/path.zsh.inc" ]] protects SDK PATH initialization
